analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call on July 14, 2026, discussing a challenging operating environment marked by global supply-side disruptions, geopolitical tensions in West Asia, and raw material inflation. Despite these headwinds, the company reported quarterly revenue of ₹532 crore and EBITDA of ₹89 crore, supported by backward integration and a diversified product portfolio including newly introduced NPK variants. Management expressed confidence in achieving robust growth and improved capacity utilization in the remaining quarters of FY27, backed by favorable monsoon developments, higher MSPs, and government subsidy support. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a 34.58% YoY growth in quarterly revenue to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY growth in Profit After Tax to ₹47.06 crore for Q1 FY27. The company highlighted that its expanded capacities at Meghnagar are contributing progressively to its performance.

guidance.claim: Management is confident in building on their momentum through the remainder of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.

guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon revival in early July triggered a rapid recovery in sowing progress and accelerated fertilizer offtake.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth due to strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP, and continued government backing through the NBS framework are creating a favorable operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving monsoon conditions, higher MSP & continued government backing through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are creating a favourable operating environment.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment for the Kharif season appears constructive for the industry.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

demand_outlook.claim: Water levels in major reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher compared to earlier periods, supporting stable fertilizer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Also, water levels in major reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher compared to earlier periods in the country.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's expanded capacities at Meghnagar, including NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA, are contributing progressively to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, raising total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with a sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

margins_costs.claim: The company was able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of the increase in input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs contributed to higher EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA per ton was in the range of Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: Global market input prices firmed up from mid-February onwards due to supply constraints, gas production tightness, and higher freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects SSP EBITDA of Rs. 1,500 to Rs. 1,600 per ton to hold broadly, while NPK EBITDA of Rs. 6,000 per ton may vary within ±3% to 4%.
margins_costs.quote: For SSP, that range should broadly hold. For NPK, EBITDA of around Rs.6,000 per ton may vary slightly, within a range of approximately ±3% to 4%.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to come down slightly during FY27 as the company absorbs part of the raw material cost increases.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved 43% capacity utilization of the NPK-DAP unit and 121% of the SSP unit during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Total fertilizer production reached 397,263 MT in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volumes in FY26 were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

capital_allocation.claim: Subsidy receivables stood at almost Rs. 400 crore while other receivables were between Rs. 300 crore and Rs. 325 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: So, subsidy receivable is almost Rs.400 crore and other receivables are in the range of Rs.300 crore to Rs.325 crore.

risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, prices of key inputs such as ammonia and sulfur increased, while phosphatic acid and rock phosphate prices also remained elevated, placing additional cost pressure on the industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices rose from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
